abstract: Human chorionic gonadotropins (hCGs) highly purified from the urine of patients with trophoblastic diseases and of healthy pregnant women contain approximately four mucin-type sugar chains in one molecule. The structures of these sugar chains were studied comparatively by using a new sensitive method to obtain mucin-type sugar chains quantitatively as radioactive oligosaccharides from a small amount of glycoproteins. The mucin-type sugar chains of all hCGs include sialylated and nonsialylated Gal beta 1----3GalNAc and Gal beta 1----4GlcNAc beta 1----6(Gal beta 1----3)GalNAc. In the case of normal hCG and hydatidiform mole hCG, oligosaccharides containing the tetrasaccharide core occupy approximately 10% of the total mucin-type sugar chains. The ratio of the tetrasaccharide containing oligosaccharides is increased prominently to approximately 60% in choriocarcinoma hCG. The proportion in invasive mole hCG was also increased, but less than the proportion of choriocarcinoma hCG.
abstract_ja: 尿から高度に精製した絨毛性疾患患者および健常妊婦のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)は、1分子中に約4つのムチン型糖鎖を含む。これらの糖鎖構造を、少量の糖タンパク質から放射性オリゴ糖として定量的に得る新規な高感度法を用いて比較検討した。すべてのhCGのムチン型糖鎖は、シアル化および非シアル化のGalβ1→3GalNAcおよびGalβ1→4GlcNAcβ1→6(Galβ1→3)GalNAcを含む。正常hCGおよび胞状奇胎hCGでは、四糖コアを含むオリゴ糖は全ムチン型糖鎖の約10%を占める。四糖含有オリゴ糖の割合は、絨毛癌hCGでは約60%へと顕著に増加する。侵入奇胎hCGでも割合は増加したが、絨毛癌hCGほどではなかった。
